notes: «قال أخبرت عن عثيم» is passive with no named teller: an unnamed gap (rule 8)
«أبيه» and «جده» are bare relations; the grandfather who came to the Prophet is the last link
«قال وأخبرني آخر» is a second isnad carrying the same saying with an addition («واختتن»): a second group, from the same head
